translations.b0036: Part 2  Building a Modern Industrial System and Consolidating and Strengthening the Foundation of the Real Economy
translations.b0037: China will continue to make the real economy the focus of its efforts to develop the economy, maintain the direction of intelligent, green and integrated development, accelerate the building of China into a manufacturing powerhouse, a quality powerhouse, a space powerhouse, a transport powerhouse and a cyber powerhouse, keep the proportion of manufacturing at a reasonable level, and build a modern industrial system with advanced manufacturing as its backbone.
translations.b0038: Chapter 4  Optimizing and Upgrading Traditional Industries
translations.b0039: China will strengthen the guiding role of national standards, the empowerment of digital, intelligent and green technologies, and the institutional constraints of environmental protection and safety, so as to consolidate and enhance the position and competitiveness of Chinese industries in the global division of labor.
translations.b0040: Section 1  Raising the Quality and Upgrading of Key Industries
translations.b0041: Adhering to the principle of guiding development in line with the situation and applying industry-specific policies, China will help key industries resolve structural problems and accelerate their upgrading toward the medium-high end. It will promote structural adjustment in the steel, petrochemical and shipbuilding industries, and strengthen and improve bases for quality steel products, first-class petrochemicals, and high-end ships and marine engineering equipment. It will advance innovation across the entire industrial chain in electronic information and mechanical equipment, develop high-end and scarce products, and accelerate breakthroughs in key components, parts and special materials. It will expand the supply of high-quality products in light industry and textiles, and consolidate and enhance the competitiveness of the construction industry. It will promote technological transformation and upgrading, develop smart manufacturing, green manufacturing and service-oriented manufacturing, and accelerate changes in industrial models and forms of corporate organization. It will develop advanced manufacturing clusters and build national demonstration zones for new industrialization. It will strengthen total quality management, deepen implementation of the manufacturing excellence quality program, and enhance the capacity of the quality and technical infrastructure. It will promote the updating and upgrading of standards, exercise strict management over safety, environmental protection, energy efficiency and quality standards, facilitate market-based mergers and reorganizations, and ensure the orderly phase-out of backward and inefficient production capacity.
translations.b0042: Section 2  Making Industrial and Supply Chains More Self-Reliant and Controllable
translations.b0043: China will implement the industrial foundation re-engineering project to accelerate breakthroughs in a number of major basic technologies, processes and products, and advance innovative applications such as advanced materials and cross-scale manufacturing. It will implement a research program for major technical equipment and achieve breakthroughs in a number of landmark items of major technical equipment. It will carry out the high-quality development initiative for key manufacturing industrial chains on a rolling basis, establish and improve risk assessment and response mechanisms for the security of industrial and supply chains, continuously strengthen its competitive advantages in rare earths, rare metals and superhard materials, and strengthen the high-quality and efficient comprehensive utilization of important strategic minerals. It will advance the development of national strategic hinterlands and the backup of key industries, and build strategic industrial bases, material reserve bases and infrastructure. It will establish a survey system for the competitiveness of the industrial foundation and strengthen support for generic technology research and development. It will improve policies for the application of first-of-their-kind major technical equipment, first batches of new materials, and first editions of software.
translations.b0044: Section 3  Improving Mechanisms for Promoting the Healthy and Orderly Development of Industries
translations.b0045: China will improve the industrial regulation and policy system, optimize the industrial layout, and strengthen coordinated support for factors of production. It will improve the production capacity monitoring and early warning mechanism, and adopt measures such as planning guidance, capacity regulation, price governance and industry self-discipline to comprehensively address “involution-style” competition. It will promote the transformation of industrial policy toward inclusive and functional approaches, and improve mechanisms for the formulation and implementation, information disclosure, evaluation and adjustment, and withdrawal of industrial policies. It will improve the tiered cultivation system for high-quality enterprises and promote the development of small and medium-sized enterprises as specialized, refined, distinctive and innovative (SRDI) enterprises. It will reasonably reduce the overall costs of manufacturing and increase support from medium- and long-term loans and credit loans for technological innovation, digital and intelligent transformation, and green development in manufacturing. It will implement the manufacturing talent support program and the knowledge renewal project for professional and technical personnel, and cultivate outstanding engineers, master craftsmen of the nation and highly skilled talent.
translations.b0046: Chapter 5  Cultivating and Expanding Emerging Industries and Future Industries
translations.b0047: China will strengthen the supply of source technologies, accelerate the development of application scenarios and ecosystems, cultivate more pillar and pioneering industries, and create new strengths for industrial development.
translations.b0048: Section 1  Developing and Expanding Emerging Industries
translations.b0049: China will accelerate the development of strategic emerging industries such as next-generation information technology, new energy, new materials, intelligent connected new energy vehicles, robotics, biopharmaceuticals, high-end equipment and aerospace; build strategic emerging industry clusters with distinctive features and complementary strengths in light of local conditions; and focus on creating a number of emerging pillar industries with great growth potential, high technological content and wide application. It will expand space for the development of the marine economy and promote the healthy and orderly development of the low-altitude economy. It will carry out large-scale application demonstration initiatives for new technologies, new products and new scenarios, intensify the cultivation and opening of application scenarios, and accelerate the scaled development of emerging industries. It will encourage the development of strategic products and services, advance the scaled and serialized development of domestically produced large aircraft, strengthen innovative applications of the BeiDou Navigation Satellite System, make solid progress in technological innovation in key areas such as intelligent driving, new-type solar cells and new-type energy storage, and support the clinical use of innovative drugs.
translations.b0050: Section 2  Making Forward-Looking Plans for Future Industries
translations.b0051: Aiming at the key fields that will lead future development, China will build a whole-chain cultivation system for future industries and make quantum technology, biomanufacturing, hydrogen and fusion energy, brain-computer interfaces, embodied intelligence and sixth-generation mobile communications new growth points. It will strengthen the identification and dynamic adjustment of future industries and step up the layout of foundational, cutting-edge and disruptive technologies. It will establish mechanisms for increasing investment in future industries and sharing risks, organize and implement demonstration projects for future industry development, and explore diverse technological pathways, typical application scenarios, viable business models and market regulation rules. It will establish a number of national future industry research institutes and proof-of-concept centers, and build a number of future industry pilot zones in regions with outstanding scientific and educational resources and a strong industrial base.
translations.b0052: Section 3  Improving the Ecosystem for Industrial Innovation and Development
translations.b0053: China will strive to create a market environment and policy system conducive to the incubation and growth of emerging industries. It will implement industrial innovation projects, improve the organization models and evaluation systems for technological innovation in strategic products, and take an integrated approach to building innovation facilities, conducting technological research and development, and iterating and upgrading products. It will improve the intellectual property protection system for emerging fields, improve the public service system for intellectual property and the network of technology trading service platforms, and implement the standardization navigation project for new industries. It will cultivate unicorn enterprises. It will establish efficient and convenient market access mechanisms suited to the development of new forms of business and explore new regulatory approaches such as “sandbox regulation” and trigger-based regulation. It will make low-altitude airspace management more refined, strengthen airworthiness certification capacity, and enhance safety assurance for low-altitude flights. It will advance legislation in emerging fields such as biopharmaceuticals, intelligent driving and the low-altitude economy.
translations.b0054: Chapter 6  Promoting High-Quality and Efficient Development of the Service Sector
translations.b0055: China will implement initiatives to expand the capacity and improve the quality of the service sector, deepen reform and opening up in the services field, improve the supporting policy system, comprehensively enhance the quality, efficiency and competitiveness of the service sector, and better leverage its role in supporting industrial upgrading, meeting public needs and expanding employment.
translations.b0056: Section 1  Extending Producer Services Toward Greater Specialization and the Higher End of the Value Chain
translations.b0057: China will strengthen weak links in producer services across the entire chain and raise the level of integrated development of modern services with advanced manufacturing and modern agriculture. It will vigorously develop scientific and technological services, enhance service capabilities in research and development and design, intellectual property, commercialization of scientific and technological achievements, and inspection, testing and certification, cultivate industrial design centers of international standard, and, relying on industrial clusters, establish a number of industry-wide generic technology platforms, pilot testing and validation platforms, and integrated and efficient quality infrastructure. It will enhance the comprehensive competitiveness of services such as financial leasing, logistics and warehousing, and human resources, expand services such as energy conservation and environmental protection and digital and intelligent transformation, and raise the share of value-added services. It will strengthen and improve business services, develop high-level third-party professional institutions, and enhance their credibility and international recognition.
translations.b0058: Section 2  Promoting High-Quality, Diversified and Convenient Development of Consumer Services
translations.b0059: Adapting to the upgrading of the household consumption structure, China will actively develop consumer services that are inclusive and accessible and offer personalized variety. It will accelerate efforts to shore up weak links in inclusive services such as elderly care, childcare and health, improve mechanisms such as government purchase of services, public construction with private operation, and private construction with public support, and support diverse providers in expanding service supply. It will encourage wholesale and retail, accommodation and catering to develop with distinctive and high-quality features, actively expand new forms of business and new models, and promote coordinated online and offline development. It will improve the quality of services such as domestic services, property management and express delivery, innovate integrated community service models, and promote brand-based and standardized development. It will rely on industries with wide-ranging spillover effects to promote the integrated development of multiple business forms. It will focus on public health, smart elderly care, cultural tourism, at-home services and other areas to cultivate a number of new growth points in consumer services.
translations.b0060: Section 3  Improving the Policy System for Service Sector Development
translations.b0061: China will relax market access in the services field, expand high-quality business entities, deepen regulatory reform, and improve cross-departmental and cross-industry approval and regulation models suited to the integration of business forms. It will expand high-standard opening up of the service sector, attract internationally renowned enterprises to invest and operate in China, and expand overseas “manufacturing plus services” business networks. It will innovate financing and land use models for the service sector, improve the pricing mechanism and supporting policies for inclusive services, and encourage the use of existing resources to renovate service facilities. It will accelerate the development of service standards in key areas such as elderly care and childcare, and implement systems for quality service commitments, certification and labeling. It will enhance the professionalism of service personnel, and improve the skills evaluation mechanism and the credit system. It will improve the statistical monitoring system for the service sector.
translations.b0062: Chapter 7  Building a Modern Infrastructure System
translations.b0063: Adhering to the principle of building moderately ahead of demand but not excessively so, China will strengthen overall planning for infrastructure, optimize its layout and structure, promote integration and connectivity, and enhance safety, resilience and operational sustainability.
translations.b0064: Section 1  Improving the Modern Comprehensive Transport System
translations.b0065: China will improve networks, strengthen connections and raise quality, strengthen cross-regional coordinated planning and integrated intermodal connectivity, and comprehensively improve the overall benefits of transport infrastructure. It will improve the main framework of the national comprehensive multidimensional transport network; build strategic trunk corridors to a high standard, including those along the coast, national borders and major rivers, those out of Xinjiang and into Tibet, and the New International Land-Sea Trade Corridor in the west; basically complete the “eight vertical and eight horizontal” high-speed railway trunk corridors and the national expressway network; upgrade high-grade inland waterway channels; and basically build world-class port clusters and airport clusters. It will strengthen coverage and accessibility in weak areas, promote the upgrading and renovation of conventional-speed railways and ordinary national and provincial highways, launch a new round of rural road improvement initiatives, strengthen railway and regional airport development in the western region, and improve the road network layout in border areas. It will build international and national comprehensive transport hub cities, strengthen the construction of collection and distribution networks and the connection of stations and yards, and improve national postal and express delivery hubs. It will improve a diversified and highly resilient international transport corridor system, promote the connectivity of cross-border transport infrastructure, and promote the healthy and orderly development of international air cargo. It will take a coordinated approach to functional improvement and green, safe and intelligent development, advance the renewal, renovation and maintenance management of transport infrastructure, strengthen safety risk assessment and monitoring and early warning, and implement projects to enhance highway safety and resilience. It will deepen reform of the comprehensive transport system and advance railway system reform and the optimization of toll road policies.
translations.b0066: Section 2  Stepping Up the Building of New Energy Infrastructure
translations.b0067: China will thoroughly implement the new energy security strategy, accelerate the building of a clean, low-carbon, safe and efficient new energy system, and build itself into an energy powerhouse. It will advance the safe, reliable and orderly replacement of fossil energy with non-fossil energy, persist in developing wind, solar, hydro, nuclear and other forms of energy simultaneously, and implement a ten-year doubling initiative for non-fossil energy. It will coordinate local consumption and outbound transmission, build clean energy bases, including wind and solar power bases in the Three-North region, integrated hydro-wind-solar bases in the southwest, coastal nuclear power, and offshore wind power, strengthen the nearby development and utilization of distributed energy, develop green hydrogen, ammonia and methanol, and actively promote concentrated solar power and geothermal energy utilization. It will strengthen the clean and efficient use of fossil energy, and advance the upgrading and transformation of coal-fired power and the replacement of bulk coal. It will strive to build a new type of power system, comprehensively enhance the complementarity, mutual support, safety and resilience of the power system, optimize the national power flow and the layout of cross-regional corridors, accelerate the building of smart grids, improve urban and rural distribution networks, make a scientific layout of pumped-storage hydropower, and vigorously develop new types of energy storage. It will increase the level of electrification of end-use energy and promote the green and low-carbon transformation of energy consumption. It will basically complete the building of a unified national electricity market system and improve the operation and dispatch mechanism of the “one national network” for oil and gas.
translations.b0068: Section 3  Accelerating the Building of a Modern National Water Network
translations.b0069: China will strengthen the building of the national water network and enhance its capacity for flood and waterlogging prevention, coordinated allocation of water resources, and urban and rural water supply. It will coordinate the prevention of basin-wide floods and local disasters, strengthen the building of flood-control reservoirs, river channels and embankments, and flood storage and detention areas, advance the systematic management of small and medium-sized rivers and the reinforcement and hazard elimination of unsafe reservoirs, and enhance flood control and risk avoidance capacity in areas with concentrated heavy rainfall. It will improve the cross-basin and cross-regional water resource allocation system and improve the main framework and key water conveyance and distribution channels of the national water network. It will strengthen water supply and irrigation guarantees, advance the construction and renovation of large and medium-sized irrigation districts in a comprehensive manner, and accelerate the building of emergency backup water source projects in cities. It will strengthen the ecological protection and governance of rivers and lakes, advance water source conservation and soil and water conservation, and enhance the self-repairing capacity of water ecosystems. It will carry out groundwater protection and governance initiatives and gradually achieve a balance between extraction and recharge.
translations.b0070: Section 4  Building New Infrastructure Moderately Ahead of Demand
translations.b0071: Focusing on supporting industrial upgrading and digital and intelligent development, China will advance the layout and construction of new infrastructure and its intensive and efficient use. It will improve information and communication networks, deepen the large-scale deployment of fifth-generation mobile communications (5G) and gigabit optical networks, advance the construction and development of 5G-Advanced (5G-A) networks and 10-gigabit optical networks and technological innovation in sixth-generation mobile communications (6G), and promote the independent iteration of the mobile Internet of Things. It will deeply advance the East Data, West Computing project to channel computing resources from the east to the west, and build a multi-tiered computing power facility system and a nationally integrated computing power network. It will implement the national blockchain network construction project. It will improve civilian space infrastructure, coordinate the construction of satellite communications, navigation and remote sensing systems, and accelerate the networking of low-orbit satellite internet. It will advance the digital and intelligent upgrading of infrastructure in transport, energy, water conservancy and other fields.
